text_block_list.text:
After training, as I was passing by
the dorms—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...They're late.
Where could they have gone...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They aren't girls to break rules.
Hope nothing bad happened.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oops—speak of the devil!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, we missed curfew!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Fuji-senpai, I'm so sorrrryyy!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back.
Rare to see you two late.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Mind telling me why?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well, um...
I was out roadworking with Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Then, passing by the station area,
there was a horse girl lost...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We talked to her, but language didn't work!
Because, you see, amazingly...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: She was a horse girl from Dubai!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: A horse girl from Dubai...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So, managing with gestures,
we searched for her homestay house!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
When we finally arrived, for a welcome party,
they treated us to huge piles of kebabs...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Kebabs...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
In the end, dance party broke out...!
We danced belly dancing together!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Belly dancing...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Then before we knew it, this late...
Truly, truly sorry!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Pfft... Ahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, might sound like a lie,
but really...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know.
You girls wouldn't lie.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Laughed precisely because I knew it was all true.
What an adventure!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Dubai miss must have been so relieved.
Good work, Suzuka, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still...
Was beside myself worrying something happened to you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Deeply relieved you're safe.
Make sure to contact me when running late.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't keep me waiting too anxiously.
...Pony-chan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek...!
Y-Yes, so sorry...!
